classification_policy.hard_gate: Must be evaluated and pass before a result can be accepted.
classification_policy.objective: May be optimized or ranked only after all applicable hard gates pass.
classification_policy.report_only: Must be reported but cannot be promoted to a hard gate after seeing results.
classification_policy.unresolved: A formal threshold or capability is not yet available; it is recorded explicitly and cannot be guessed.

hard_constraints.definition: All H0 manifest hashes match current files.
Only outputs/internal_wiper_moveit_inputs/open_arch_tcp_poses_base_link.csv and open_arch_seed_joints.csv; each has 181 data rows.
All accepted joint states satisfy the loaded MoveIt model bounds.
Maximum absolute signed TCP/nozzle-to-surface distance error.
hard_constraints.threshold: <= 13 mm for Stage 0/1 scope; 0.260 m nominal

hard_constraints.definition: Maximum TCP +Z to oriented surface-normal angular deviation.
Maximum adjacent circular joint change in the baseline graph.
Post-Ruckig native jerk with explicit jerk_semantics label.
hard_constraints.threshold: per-joint max_jerk; finite-difference jerk cannot substitute

hard_constraints.definition: No self or robot/world collision at a declared state.
No collision in all samples of adaptive discrete joint interpolation.
No robot/world collision against declared world geometry.
Stage 3 writes only to stage3-prefixed/config/stage3/output namespace and does not overwrite frozen artifacts.
No FJT send path, no robot motion, no physical execution, no Stage 3 formal ML run.

report_only_metrics.reason: Timer scope is diagnostic until all phase boundaries are implemented.
Formal Spray-ON/OFF ML evaluation is outside H1 authorization.
No Stage 3 dataset/model exists in H1.
Must not be confused with native trajectory jerk.

unresolved_items.reason: Requires calibrated footprint/deposition model and an approved acceptance band.
Capability is qualified separately; no safety threshold is inferred from a positive distance.
Dataset split and future model are not present in H1.

freeze_rule: No metric may be promoted from objective or report_only to hard_gate after an experiment result is observed without a versioned contract revision and a new gate run.
